description: OKR generator and checker — Turn a goal into OKRs: qualitative objectives with measurable outcome key results (metric, baseline, target, direction, how measured), initiatives, risks, assumptions and metrics to instrument - plus an offline quality check that flags task-style or vague key results, missing numbers, numeric objectives and unknown baselines (score + grade) and a Markdown version. Params: goal= (required), team=, period= (e.g. Q1 2027), context= (current numbers help), objectives=1-5 (default 2), krs=2-5 per objective (default 3). Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).

goal.description: grow self-serve revenue without adding sales headcount
